translations.web: Yes, for your sake we are killed all day long. We are regarded as sheep for the slaughter.
translations.bsb: Yet for Your sake we face death all day long; we are considered as sheep to be slaughtered.
translations.kjv: Yea, for thy sake are we killed all the day long; we are counted as sheep for the slaughter.
translations.asv: Yea, for thy sake are we killed all the day long; We are accounted as sheep for the slaughter.
